name: file-search-by-usage
title: File Search by Usage
description: Search local and cloud files in one place, ranked by usage.
author: raycast_file_search

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files and Folders
commands.description: Search files and folders across local and cloud storage, ranked by usage.

commands.name: browse-finder
commands.title: Search Finder's Current Folder
commands.description: Search from the frontmost Finder folder, ranked by usage.

commands.name: index-shortcuts
commands.title: Index Google Drive
commands.description: Index Google Drive shortcuts and shared-folder contents that Spotlight cannot find.

commands.name: delete-data
commands.title: Delete All Data and Cache
commands.description: Delete usage history, pins, searches, learned shortcuts, and cached indexes without touching your files.

preferences.name: showHidden
preferences.title: Listing
preferences.label: Show hidden files
preferences.description: Include dotfiles and other hidden entries in the listing.

preferences.name: showScores
preferences.label: Show usage scores
preferences.description: Show each item's usage score in the list. Useful for understanding why results are ordered the way they are.
